description.value: Coast Sundance Lodge is a full-service hotel belonging to the Coast Hotels chain, a network of properties spanning Canada and the United States. Located in BC's Thompson-Okanagan region, it serves as a base for visitors to the surrounding mountain and resort terrain. Touring cyclists passing through will find a branded hotel experience with the consistency of a managed chain property.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched from coasthotels.com/coast-sundance-lodge consists almost entirely of chain-wide navigation elements, membership rate tables, and boilerplate — no property-specific amenity details are available for Coast Sundance Lodge. OSM confirms the hotel at 3160 Creekside Way with phone +1-250-578-0200 and an internet_access=wlan tag, but per rules OSM amenity tags are not authoritative without website corroboration. Notably, Coast Sundance Lodge does not appear in the visible (though truncated) BC hotel list on the chain's FAQs subpage, which is a minor flag but not grounds for exclusion given the list was cut off.
concerns: Coast Sundance Lodge does not appear in the visible portion of the BC hotel listing on the chain's FAQs subpage (list was truncated, so absence may not be significant).
Website content was entirely chain-wide navigation/boilerplate — no property-specific information could be extracted, leaving all amenities unverifiable.
OSM address lacks city and postal code.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Coast Hotels is a well-established Canadian hotel chain; this is a real, publicly accessible hotel at a legitimate address with a working chain website and OSM record showing no signs of closure.
